messages:
anil: rolling out feature/batch-scheduling now — plan: canary @ 5% -> 25% -> 100%. target window ~45m. canary start 10:30 PT. tagging @jess @maya to run smoke + monitoring. rollback prepped.

jess: got it. i'll run the smoke checklist and watch p50/p95. will ping when i hit each gate.

maya: infra watching. dashboards pinned: svc/latency, svc/errors, queue-depth. alert thresholds set (errors > 1% or p95 > 300ms).

darren: i'll be on standby for rollback. preferred method: abort traffic and pin to v1.2.4 image. rollback script is /ops/rollback.sh.

jess: starting smoke run now. quick commands:
```
# run smoke locally against canary routing
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.test/v1/generate -d '{"input":"smoke test"}' | jq .
python tools/smoke/check_endpoints.py --target canary --duration 60
```
I'll paste results after the run.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started (5%) — target group: us-west-2-a. rollout id: r-2026-2267890123.

maya: first 2m: latency p50 +0.9ms, p95 +3ms. error rate 0.12%. no new infra alerts.

jess: smoke run output: all endpoints returned 200, sample outputs look good. memory stable. attaching short snippet: `generated tokens: 48, avg latency 82ms`

anil: good so far. plan: hold 5% for 8m, then bump to 25% if no spikes.

jess: found tiny template mismatch in rerouting header (missing x-cust-id) that only shows up under new batching. i'll push a one-line fix to PR #4872 and hotpatch if needed. keeping canary paused until patch lands.

darren: agree pause. if patch rollout, have rollback path ready. patch flow: patch -> canary 5% -> observe 5m -> bump.

anil: OK, pause accepted. notify when PR merged.

jess: PR #4872 merged (sha: a1b2c3d). deploying hotfix to canary now.

deploy-bot: hotfix deployed to canary (5%) — deployment id: r-2026-2267890123-hotfix.

maya: 4m after hotfix: errors 0.08%, p95 unchanged. no spike in DB connections.

jess: reran smoke script post-hotfix: all green. sample runs: 0 errors, avg latency 80ms.

anil: proceeding to 25% in 2m. hold at 25% for 20m then final ramp if clean. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scaled traffic to 25% (canary -> ramp stage).

maya: watch window started for 25%. immediate metrics: small uptick in qps as expected, error rate steady at 0.1%.

jess: quick code-review ping: no new regressions seen in logs. small noisy warn about cache-miss — not impacting correctness.

darren: rollback checklist verified: image pinned, db-migration flag off, runbook doc link /playbooks/rollbacks/batch-scheduling.md. on-call channel is clear.

anil: continuing on schedule. if anyone sees errors >0.8% or p95 > 350ms, call rollback. otherwise final ramp after hold.

jess: end-of-hold smoke: 20m window clean. marking smoke: green ✅

maya: observability: no alerts, latency within SLO, error rate stable.

anil: bumping to 100% now.

deploy-bot: final ramp to 100% completed. rollout r-2026-2267890123 is now active.

jess: post-rollout quick sanity: all endpoints ok, minor cache warn only. i'll open follow-up ticket for cache tuning.

maya: closing watch window. will keep dashboards unmuted for 2hrs.

darren: thanks all — rollback not required. closing on-call.

anil: great work team. saved notes: PR#4872 hotfix, rollback ready, smoke green. archiving rollout artifacts and creating follow-up tasks. :party_parrot:
